description: Recurring FDA warning-letter enforcement themes that hit the beverage industry, with what triggers them and the governing CFR. These are representative themes, not specific letters; confirm current actions against FDA's live Warning Letters database (linked). FDA enforces food safety and labeling largely through these letters, so they are a leading signal of where attention is.

themes.theme: Unapproved drug and disease claims on functional beverages
themes.what_triggers: Marketing a beverage with claims to treat, cure, or prevent disease (immunity, anxiety, sleep, weight loss) turns it into an unapproved new drug in FDA's view. Influencer and AI-drafted copy counts as the brand's claim.
themes.beverage_note: Highest-frequency theme for functional and wellness drinks. Route every claim through legal before launch.

themes.theme: CBD and other unlawful additives in beverages
themes.what_triggers: Adding CBD or other substances FDA has not authorized for food makes the beverage adulterated. FDA has issued many warning letters for CBD-infused drinks.
themes.beverage_note: Do not add unauthorized actives to a conventional beverage.

themes.what_triggers: Using a color additive that is not listed for the use, not batch-certified where required, or used above its limit adulterates the product.
themes.beverage_note: Ties directly to the dye phase-out and Red No. 3 removal.

themes.what_triggers: Juice and juice-containing beverages must follow HACCP controls including a 5-log pathogen reduction; missing plans or controls draw letters.
themes.beverage_note: Applies to any juice content in flavored or fruit-forward lines.

themes.theme: Acidified and low-acid beverage process controls
themes.what_triggers: Shelf-stable acidified or low-acid beverages require filed processes and registration; failures in scheduled processes or registration draw letters.
themes.beverage_note: Relevant to canned and bottled shelf-stable products.

themes.what_triggers: Failure to register a facility or to implement hazard analysis and risk-based preventive controls draws enforcement.

cfr.citation: 21 CFR Part 117 (Preventive Controls for Human Food)

themes.beverage_note: Baseline GMP and food-safety system expectation for any producer.
